result.description:
IT Systems Analyst
Full-time
Glow Health Care Australia Pty Ltd trading as Glow Health Care Australia
Parramatta, NSW
Salary: $80,000–$100,000 plus superannuation
About the Role
Glow Health Care Australia is seeking an experienced IT Systems Analyst to support and improve the technology systems used across our disability, aged care, home care, allied health and NDIS service operations.
In this role, you will work with managers, employees, external vendors and technology teams to identify business needs, analyse existing systems and implement practical technology solutions. You will help ensure our systems are secure, reliable, compliant and aligned with the organisation’s operational requirements.
Duties and Responsibilities
•	Analyse existing systems, applications and business processes to identify opportunities for improvement. 
•	Consult with stakeholders to gather and document functional and technical requirements. 
•	Translate business requirements into system designs and technical specifications. 
•	Prepare system workflows, process maps, data mappings and functional documentation. 
•	Recommend system enhancements, new applications and improvements to existing platforms. 
•	Coordinate the implementation and rollout of new systems and system upgrades. 
•	Develop and conduct system, integration and user acceptance testing. 
•	Investigate system defects and coordinate resolutions with vendors and development teams. 
•	Support the integration of third-party applications with internal systems and platforms. 
•	Monitor system interfaces and data flows to maintain accuracy and interoperability. 
•	Prepare user guides, technical procedures, training materials and system documentation. 
•	Provide Level 2 and Level 3 support for complex system-related issues. 
•	Assist with staff training and change-management activities during system implementations. 
•	Ensure systems comply with privacy, cybersecurity, data-governance and healthcare requirements. 
•	Conduct post-implementation reviews and recommend further system improvements. 
Skills and Qualifications
•	Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Information Systems or a related discipline. 
•	At least two to three years of relevant experience as a Systems Analyst, Business Systems Analyst or in a similar ICT position. 
•	Experience analysing, implementing and supporting organisational or enterprise systems. 
•	Strong knowledge of requirements gathering, process mapping and technical documentation. 
•	Experience with system integration, APIs, databases and data modelling. 
•	Experience conducting integration testing and user acceptance testing. 
•	Familiarity with SQL, Visio, Jira, Confluence or similar tools. 
•	Understanding of Agile, Waterfall or other software-development methodologies. 
•	Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. 
•	Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
•	Ability to communicate technical information clearly to non-technical stakeholders. 
•	Knowledge of information security, privacy and data-governance principles. 
•	Experience in healthcare, disability, aged care, community services or NDIS operations is desirable. 
•	ITIL, CBAP, PRINCE2 or similar certification would be advantageous. 
How to Apply
Please submit your résumé and a cover letter outlining your relevant qualifications and experience.
Glow Health Care Australia is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applications from suitably qualified candidates from all backgrounds.
result.title: IT Systems Analyst

result.description:
Job Details
-  Occupation: Project Administrator
-  Base Pay: $80,000 - $90,000 + Super
-  Contract Type: Permanent
-  Work Type: Full Time
-  Industry: Height Safety Services
-  Sector: Privately Held Company

About the Role
Safe Height Pty Ltd trading as SAFE MOUNT are a specialist provider of Height Safety Compliance  Solutions across SEQ. Our services include System Design, Installation of Height Safety Systems, Certification and Audit, as well as Harness & PPE Inspection services. Due to continued growth, we are seeking an experienced Project Administrator to support the planning, coordination and administration of multiple concurrent projects and service programs for the existing and new clients. The role requires regular travel along southeast Queensland between various projects with possible interstate trips. This role suits a highly capable, analytically-minded professional — potentially with an engineering, scientific, mining or other complex industrial background — who can quickly learn technical and regulatory frameworks, interpret data and adapt across multiple concurrent, complex projects as per various customers’ requirements. 

Skills
-  Project Coordination
-  Contract Administration
-  Contract Management
-  Project Scheduling
-  Microsoft Excel
-  Project Reporting
-  Contractor Management
-  Stakeholder Management
-  Compliance Management
-  Document Control
-  Change Management
-  Data Analysis
-  Bluebeam Revu 

Skills & Experience
-  Tertiary qualification in a technical, engineering, scientific, project management, business or related discipline.
-  Background in engineering, construction, mining, resources, manufacturing or other complex industrial/technical sectors will be highly regarded.
-  Minimum 3 years’ experience in project coordination, project administration, project controls or similar project support roles.
-  Demonstrated experience managing interfaces between clients, contractors, suppliers and technical professionals.
-  Experience coordinating projects involving technical design, site installation works, contractor management and regulatory compliance requirements.
-  Experience in schedule monitoring, progress tracking and project performance reporting.
-  Experience in communication with different levels of stakeholders from site labour to decision makers in the client's procurement team
-  Experience supporting project change management and contract variation processes.
-  Advanced Microsoft Excel skills including reporting, forecasting, data analysis and performance tracking.
-  Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
-  Strong analytical and organisational abilities.
-  Demonstrated ability to rapidly learn, analyse and apply new technical, regulatory and operational information across complex, fast-moving project environments.
-  Reading CAD drawings and liaising with Design Project managers and Development Managers

Main Duties / Responsibilities
-  Coordinate and administer height safety compliance inspection programs, system installation projects, and design services.
-  Develop, maintain and review project schedules, work programs, resource plans and project documentation.
-  Prepare and coordinate tender documentation, service agreements, work orders and contract documentation, ensuring project requirements, pricing, scope changes and approvals are accurately recorded throughout the project lifecycle.
-  Coordinate day-to-day communication and workflow between clients, engineers, contractors, installers, inspectors and suppliers to ensure activities are delivered safely, efficiently and in accordance with project schedules.
-  Monitor project and service delivery performance against contractual requirements, compliance obligations and client expectations.
-  Act as a key point of contact for clients, contractors and suppliers by coordinating responses to project enquiries, facilitating communication between stakeholders and assisting with the timely resolution of operational issues.
-  Maintain accurate electronic project records, inspection reports, certification documentation, drawings, registers and compliance documentation to support project delivery and audit requirements.
-  Compile project performance information from multiple operational sources, analyse trends and prepare management reports covering project progress, productivity, compliance performance and service delivery outcomes.
-  Support project change management processes, including assessment, documentation and tracking of project variations.
-  Monitor contractor activities against agreed schedules, scopes of work and project milestones, identifying delays, quality concerns or scope changes requiring management review.
-  Support procurement and subcontractor coordination activities.
-  Prepare project documentation including client reports, operational summaries, project status updates, meeting papers and internal business documentation to support decision-making.
-  Provide project support to senior management by monitoring project risks, escalating critical issues, coordinating follow-up actions and assisting with implementation of operational decisions.
-  Identify delivery risks, compliance issues and operational constraints that may affect project schedules or client commitments.
-  Coordinate height safety inspection, installation and certification activities to ensure compliance with regulatory and client requirements.
-  Monitor contractor performance and support continuous improvement initiatives across projects and service programs.
Experience
-  To be considered for this role, applicants must demonstrate a minimum of 3 years’ experience in project coordination, project administration, project controls or similar project support roles within engineering, construction, industrial services, infrastructure, compliance or other relevant technical service environments. 

Performance Goals
-  Timely delivery of height safety projects and annual compliance service programs.
-  Effective planning, scheduling and delivery of projects from tender stage to practical completion and handover
-  Accurate and effective project reporting.
-  Efficient coordination of contractors, suppliers and stakeholders.
-  Compliance with contractual, regulatory and client requirements.
-  Continuous improvement of project administration, reporting and coordination processes.

Other Requirements
-  Current, open driver’s licence, with willingness to travel regularly across South East Queensland and occasionally interstate.

How to Apply
Submit a resume and cover letter to info@safemount.com.au or via the application link.
We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender, cultural background, disability or other protected attributes.

result.description:
Dubbo Grain Packing (DGP)
Grain Storage & Handling Site, Trangie, NSW 2823

Full Time General Clerk
$98,000 per annum plus superannuation

Summary
The General Clerk provides administrative and clerical support to the operations of Dubbo
Grain Packing (DGP). The position is responsible for maintaining records, processing
documentation, data entry, preparing correspondence, coordinating office activities, and
supporting grain storage and handling operations through efficient administrative services.

Duties and Responsibilities

General Administrative Support
•	Perform a range of clerical and administrative duties to support site operations.
•	Prepare, process and file business documents, forms and correspondence.
•	Maintain electronic and physical filing systems.
•	Receive, sort and distribute incoming mail and communications.
•	Assist management with routine administrative tasks.

Record Keeping and Data Entry
•	Enter and update operational information into company databases and record systems.
•	Maintain records relating to grain receivals, dispatches and inventory movements.
•	Verify information for accuracy and completeness.
•	Retrieve records and documents as requested by management.
•	Ensure records are maintained in accordance with company procedures.

Document Preparation
•	Prepare routine reports, spreadsheets, forms and correspondence.
•	Compile operational data for management reporting purposes.
•	Assist with preparation of meeting agendas, minutes and administrative documentation.
•	Maintain document registers and administrative records.

Customer and Stakeholder Liaison
•	Respond to routine enquiries from customers, suppliers, transport operators and
•	contractors.
•	Direct enquiries to appropriate personnel when required.
•	Provide administrative support to visitors and site personnel.
•	Maintain professional communication with internal and external stakeholders.

Operational Administration Support
•	Assist with processing grain receival and dispatch documentation.
•	Maintain weighbridge and transport records.
•	Support scheduling and coordination of administrative activities during harvest periods.
•	Assist operational staff with document management and record maintenance.

Compliance Administration
•	Maintain records required for workplace health and safety, training and compliance
•	purposes.
•	Assist with preparation of documentation for audits and inspections.
•	Ensure administrative records are current, accurate and readily accessible.
•	Support implementation of company policies and procedures.

Reporting
•	Prepare routine administrative and operational reports.
•	Compile statistical information and summaries as requested by management.
•	Assist with monitoring and reporting of administrative activities.

Skills and Competencies
•	Strong administrative and clerical skills.
•	Accurate data entry and record management capability.
•	Sound computer and office software skills.
•	Strong organisational and time management skills.
•	Effective written and verbal communication skills.
•	Attention to detail and accuracy.

Qualifications and Experience
•	Certificate III, Certificate IV or higher qualification in Business Administration or a related field; or
•	At least one year of relevant clerical or administrative experience.
•	At least 12 months experience with a program called Agtech and Agri-digital.
